name: 8bit-sfx
generator: synthesized on demand by src/ — these files are an optional export

character.jump: rising square hops, snappy or floaty tails
character.coin: bright two-note pickup blips, classic coin grab
character.laser: fast downward zaps, clean or warbled pew
character.explosion: noise booms, dry cracks to sub-heavy rolling blasts
character.powerup: rising scale fanfares, bright pickup arpeggios
character.hit: blunt impacts, noise burst over a diving low thud
character.blip: tiny UI ticks and menu selects, crisp square clicks
character.alarm: alternating two-tone sirens, frantic to steady
character.drone: sustained bass hums, gentle to seasick wobble
character.jingle: short melodic stingers, 3-6 notes resolving upward
character.ambient: wind gusts, cricket chorus, cave drips, thunder, rain, shimmer pads
character.ui: menu clicks, hovers, toggles, dings, error buzzes, key ticks
character.voice: chip-speech babble, grunts, hums, laughs, gasps, sighs, hey! calls
character.dog: chip barks big and small, yips, whines, whimpers, growls, pants, howls
character.zombie: undead groans, moans, hisses, gurgles, rattling breath, snarls
character.monster: creature roars, screeches, snarls, chitter, stomps, flaps, squelches
character.water: drips, splashes, pours, streams, underwater blubs
character.fire: crackling campfires, ignition whooshes, torch flutter, sizzles, ember pops
character.footstep: steps on grass, gravel, stone, wood, snow, mud, puddles
character.mech: creaks, slams, latches, levers, switches, rattles, ratchets, key jangles
character.person: heartbeats, breaths, sneezes, snores, claps, gut growls
character.rpg: sword swings, spells, loot jingles, level-ups, warps, save chimes
character.kick: tight chip kicks, 808 drops, gated and crushed thumps
character.snare: noise-and-tone backbeats, cracks, gated slams, rimshots, flams
character.hihat: crisp closed ticks, open sizzles, pedal chicks, metallic sheen
character.tom: tuned rack and floor toms, falling bends, roto rises, fills
character.cymbal: long crashes, pinging rides, ride bells, splashes, chinas, chokes
character.perc: tuned cowbells, blocks, claves, shakers, congas, agogo bells
character.bass: plucked and sustained chip bass, acid sweeps, wobbles, slaps
character.sub: 808 slides, deep drops, gated and growling sub-bass
character.lead: square and PWM chip leads, glides, licks, echoes, stabs
character.pluck: harp and marimba plucks, glassy mallets, muted stabs, octave doubles
character.arp: chord-tone arpeggio runs, octave jumps, glissandi, ratchets
character.chord: tuned chord stabs, power chords, wide voicings, gated chops
character.bell: struck bronze bells, tubular chimes, music-box tines, shimmer tails
character.organ: drawbar stacks, church pipes, rock bite, leslie swirl, percussive taps
character.string: bowed swells, tremolo and spiccato bowing, pizzicato, detuned ensembles
character.brass: chip brass stabs, fanfares, swells, muted buzz, section falls
character.reed: breathy chip flutes, hollow clarinet, nasal oboe, ocarina, pan pipes
character.pad: warm detuned beds, glassy stacks, dark slabs, filter sweeps, gated pulses
character.riser: noise sweeps, pitch glides, gated builds, drum rolls, filter falls
character.impact: cinematic booms, metallic slams, sub drops, braams, debris tails
character.glitch: buffer stutters, bitcrush bursts, tape stops, garbled data chirps
character.vinyl: crackle beds, needle drops, tape hiss, wow/flutter, static, motor hum
